title: 一架纸飞机
subtitle: A Paper Glider
description: 看一看纸飞机，再用英语说出一次试飞的想法。
objectives: 用英语描述一个看见的部位
说出一项想尝试的改动

steps.english: Hi! What do you notice about this little paper glider?
steps.hint: You can say: I see a big wing.

reading.passage: A paper glider has wings. What do you notice about this one?
reading.goal: Name or describe one visible feature.
reading.teacherNotes: Greet briefly. Point to wing while saying wing. Accept any observation, then invite the learner to say if they want to try a flight.
reading.followUp: Which part do you notice first?

steps.english: What would you change before your second flight?
steps.hint: You can say: I would change one fold.

reading.passage: Try two flights. Change one fold and see what happens.
reading.goal: Suggest one change and one observation.
reading.teacherNotes: Point to flight-path while explaining the two trials. Treat flight differences as things to observe. If interrupted, answer first and return to the comparison.
reading.followUp: What would you look for on the second flight?

steps.english: What else would you like to try with a paper glider?
steps.hint: You can say: I would try a bigger wing.

reading.passage: Try two flights. Change one fold and see what happens.
reading.goal: Share an idea in the learner's own words.
reading.teacherNotes: Follow the learner's idea and model one useful expression. Let the learner choose when to finish.
reading.followUp: What do you think might happen?
